purpose_context: Today a Felix component can fail or go stale and Kent only finds out through downstream symptoms, sometimes days later. This mission builds a deterministic canary runner that reads the health_check each component already declares in service-inventory.json, computes its health per the ADR-0006 lifecycle contract, and emits stale/failed conditions to the #701 unified alert bus — closing the recurring silent-failure class as the core build of Foundation 1 (#516).
purpose_tldr: Automatically detect silent failures of Felix components by evaluating each component's declared health check on a schedule and routing failures to the unified alert bus.
